rom: DQIX USA (YDQE), headless melonDS debug build, FreeBIOS + generated firmware

camera_follow_xyz.note: x, height, z of the point the camera follows (= hero). Written by matrix code at 0x020C1CD8 (str r1,[r9,#0x24], r9=0x0210A110); writing it does not move the hero. Copy at 0x0210A250.

dialog_render_buffers.note: Rendered dialog text, ASCII. Lines start '//Speaker// '. Never zero it (game data shares the range); diff before/after a talk to get the new speaker.

dialog_script_text.note: Raw script of the talked-to NPC is loaded into heap (seen 0x0238xxxx-0x023Axxxx) with markup: <PAGE> <ADD> <YESNO> <PAD_WAIT> <LEADER> <,> <1>=apostrophe, menus as <N=1>..</N>. Search RAM for '//Name//' to read an NPC's whole script after talking once.

battle_state.note: [0] 0 on field/town, 3 from ~50 frames after touching a monster until the battle ends, then 1 for ~60 frames while the field reloads, then 0. [1] 0x20 during the swirl transition, 0x22 in battle. [2] 4 = fighting (set at contact, before [0]), 6 = won (victory, experience and gold messages, which wait for A), back to 4 then 0 as the field returns; after Flee it goes to 0 with [0] = 1.

menu_text_buffer.note: Markup of the last built list menu: '<CURSOR=1><N=0>Attack</N><X=69>...<N=3>Abilities</N>' (battle member menu), '<CURSOR=0><N=0>Fight</N>\n<N=1>Examine</N>...' (battle top menu), '<CURSOR=0><PLTT=15><N=0>Kheg</N>...' (party target list). The CURSOR digit (0x02119004) follows the live cursor while that menu is open; once it closes the buffer keeps the old menu or a message, and a battle's first top menu is never written there.

game_state.note: GameState: objects_[0xe9] at +8 (GameObject*), protagonistObjectIndex_ at +0x3AC; hero = *(0x020F33E0 + 4 * *(0x020F3784)) (0x022BBBDC in every save tried). GameObject: Object3D at +0, baseStats_ +0x134, currentStats_ +0x138 (currHP u16 +0, currMP +2, maxHP +4, maxMP +6, attack +8, defense +0xA, status flags u32 +0x14: bit 0 dead), party member data +0x150, ladder state +0x26C.

zone.note: Zone3D: +8 points at a struct whose +5 holds the map short name ('C01' Stornway, 'R04M01' Quester's Rest 1F, 'D08M06' Plumbed Depths B3; data/map/<name>.ambl); NULL on the title screen. Map entity lists by type at +0xA8 + 4*type (first entity; entity: pos fx32[3] at +8, angle s16 at +0x20, next at +0x70). Type 9 = ladder ends (pairs: +0x31 bit 0 set on the top end; func_ov017_021975e4 starts the climb).

ladder_state.note: Struct_02037d10: [0] 1 while on a ladder (func_02039d7c returns it), [1] phase 0 approach, 1 hasigo_in, 2 hasigo_loop, then out; 0 again once off at the other end.

hero_actor_position.note: The hero's own x, y, z: x equals camera_follow x; on the world map z = camera z - 11.76 and y is ground height (~0.3). Party member actors follow every 0x116C0 bytes (0x022CD2E0, 0x022DE9A0, 0x022F0060). Field monsters: 0x198-byte entries from about 0x022F0C74, position at +0 and +0x40 (a she-slime at 0x022F0E0C).

coordinates.units: fx32, 4096 = 1 unit; +x = screen right, +z = screen down (field camera is not axis-aligned: screen moves leak a little into the other axis)
coordinates.stuck_test: position (x,z) changes < 0.05 over a 3-frame step for 3 steps = blocked; stairs change height (y) while x/z barely move

input.keys: A B Select Start Right Left Up Down R L X Y; hold 3-4 frames per press, menus need ~12-20 frames between presses, text needs 40-90 frames
input.close_dialog: B (pressing A after a conversation ends re-talks to the NPC you face)

boot: run 2400 frames from power-on to the title
Start, wait 90; A, wait 90 (adventure log list); A, wait 360 (loads the save)
A twice (welcome text), then B to close; saves made at a church open the priest dialog

battle.top_menu_note: cursor is kept between turns (starts on Fight)
battle.member_menu_note: two columns (0-2 left, 3-5 right; Right/Left switch column); opens on the commanding member's own panel and resets to Attack every turn. Attack against a single enemy needs no target pick.
battle.lists: Items: 4 per page, Right = next page, then a party target list. Spells: 4 per page (MP cost shown in the help box), then a target list for single-target spells. Target list order Kheg, Garrek, Natalia, Melanie.

battle.hand_cursor: the yellow hand on the bottom screen marks a menu waiting for input: pixels #fbf349 #fbcb28 #fbba08 (>= 5 of them); none while messages, rounds or results show. Centroid by menu: top (75, 210), member menu (75, 213) for the first member, +40 y per member row (Garrek 253), item list (115, 204), target list (163, 202), Melanie's spell list (131, 324). It bobs ~2.5 px in x and < 1 px in y.

grottos.zone_ids: u16 at 0x020FB3F0 (Zone3D currentZoneID_): towns 1xx (C01 Stornway 100, church C01M09 109), world fields 200NN (F02 Western Stornway 20002), Quester's Rest 50401, regular grotto floors 40001..41100 (Iron Icepit B1 Z00M21 = 40021), legacy boss grottos 41101..41505 (Zoma Lv3 Z01M95 = 41101).
grottos.treasure_map_menu: X, A (Items), Down x2 (Treasure Maps), A (wait 200): 8 maps per page, Right/Left change page and wrap, the cursor is remembered across openings and sort changes (Select cycles By Type / By Status / By Level). grottos.active_map: GameState+0x63E4 = 0x020F97BC GrottoStruct: entrance zone u16 +0xC, entrance x/y/z fx32 +0x10 (world coords like hero+0x44), picture name +0x1C ('mapt_005'), map name +0x2C, active TreasureMapMetadata +0x6C (location byte +21).
grottos.save_maps: TreasureMapMetadata[99] at .sav offset 0x5E8E, 0x1C each: byte0 bits 0-2 state (1 undiscovered, 4 cleared), bits 3-4 type (1 regular, 2 legacy), location +21, quality/legacy boss +23, legacy level +24, seed +26.

battle_skills.magic_mirror: Kheg: Abilities (member menu Right 1), page 6 of 15 (Right x5), row 3 = Magic Mirror. It sets status bit 0x200 (stats+0x14) on Kheg only and lasts about 2 rounds. battle_skills.reflect_calls: func_ov024_021e9f68 runs once per spell target (returns 0 also when it reflects). func_ov024_021eda60 is never called with every member on 'Follow Orders', not even in the Zoma fight: its callers are tactic/AI condition checks (func_ov024_021ed9dc, _021eda78, _021ee0f0.._021eeab8).
battle_skills.sterlings_whistle: Kheg's Sterling's whistle calls the Starflight Express, not monsters.

follower_bit.note: GameObject+0x1CE bit 4: follower hidden/stacked on the leader (set by func_02039d48 / func_02039df4 and on ladders); members 1-3 have it right after leaving a building (Stornway church -> C01). func_02039d58 clears it; in the town, battle, event and grotto runs it was only called on members whose bit was already clear (battle start for all 4 members, zone entry for the leader).

multiplayer.host: Invite friends: needs a free party slot (with 4 members Pavo refuses: 'You have a sufficiency of companions'), then asks to save the adventure log, then opens the Rapportal and adds Misc. > Call to Arms
multiplayer.guest: Visit another world: companions stay behind ('you alone may pass'), then searches and lists worlds; pick the host's world
multiplayer.verified_2026_10_19: Two headless consoles (host Kheg save, guest Ayla save) joined: host shows 'Ayla has arrived!', Ayla joins Kheg's party bar, guest movement mirrors on the host. Packet log over ~15 s: host 649 CMD + 649 ACK, guest 650 replies.
recipe: host: patty_drop_off(F, 0) once per save (party must have a free slot), then host_invite(F, 0)
guest: guest_search(F, 1) until Pavo lists the host's world ('Kheg  1 more player can join')
then set_pacing(60), c.start() on both (live), L = Field(cons, live=True), guest_join_live(L, 1)
frame-count runs break once a session exists: a console that stops leaves the other waiting on wireless replies; keep both live and stop them with stop_after(0)
guest_pavo_prompts: 'You wish to venture into the unknown'
'you alone, as a Celestrian, may pass' (party of 4)
Yes/No 'Companions must await your return' -> Yes
list of worlds -> A on the host
Yes/No 'venture into the world of <host>' -> Yes
headless_notes: With the Rapportal open the host polls LocalMP with 0 ms waits many times per frame. The headless Platform::Semaphore_TryWait used to sleep a Windows tick on 0 ms and the host ran at 2 fps; fixed, now ~160 lockstep frames/s for two consoles.
Group runs of several consoles use a per-frame barrier (lockstep); a console that hits a break releases the barrier.

Checkpoints in states/ of the play data (N = console 0 host, 1 guest; load with host.sav/guest.sav from the same folder): inn.N (both inside Quester's Rest), rapportal.N (host at Pavo's 'Call to Arms' yes/no after inviting, guest at the inn entrance), found_world.N (guest's Pavo list shows Kheg), mp_joined.N (session joined, consoles stopped).
multiplayer.qt_verified_2026_10_19: Qt frontend, two instances in one process (System > Multiplayer > new instance), each boots the ROM then loads mp_joined.0 / mp_joined.1: session holds, host party bar keeps Ayla and mirrors guest movement. Control build without the Wifi::DoSavestate MP_Begin/End change: host shows Ayla has disappeared. and the guest drops back to boot. Fresh Qt configs have no keyboard mapping (Instance*.Keyboard = -1).
